text:
tom_lee: Quick heads-up — SI partner (AcmeSI) pinged product marketing + security asking for 'proof of KMS integration' and pen-scan ownership before we go live on their marketplace listing. They want minimal artifacts we can provide and who will upload.

ana_g: Do we have a canonical list? I can hand off uploads but need the checklist.

marcus: Minimal bundle we've shared previously: SOC2 cover page (redacted), high-level pen test exec summary (non-sensitive), pen-test attestation letter, network scan summary (no exploitable detail), and KMS integration note (key type, KMS provider, who holds keys).

si_partner_rep: @tom_lee thanks — timeline is tight, partner legal wants the artifacts by EOD Thurs to prep listing copy. Do you accept presigned upload links?

tom_lee: Yes presigned is fine. We just need owners + TTL + a small manifest. @ana_g can you own presign uploads?

ana_g: I can. Plan: I generate short-lived presigned S3 links (48h) and drop into their secure intake. Need to confirm exact object names and redaction status.

marcus: For redaction: we will remove IPs, internal hostnames, and any PII. Provide an excerpt of SOC2 (controls list + auditor name) only, not the full report. For pen test, provide an exec summary and a signed attestation from the pentester confirming scope and that no critical findings remain.

si_partner_rep: Sounds good. Can you also confirm the KMS statement format? They asked for more than just "we use AWS KMS" — they want proof we don't hold partner keys.

marcus: KMS statement should include: KMS provider, key type (symmetric/asymmetric), key owner (Redwood or customer-managed), whether HSM-backed, and an architecture diagram link (private). Example phrasing: \"Redwood-Managed AWS KMS CMKs (HSM-backed) are used for service-level encryption of model artifacts; customers may optionally bring their own keys (BYOK) via our KMS integration. Redwood never transmits plaintext keys to partners.\"

sec_ops_bot: [automated] Evidence policy reminder: uploaded artifacts must have an assigned owner and retention TTL <= 90 days unless escalated to compliance@redwood.com.

ana_g: Ok I'll create a manifest `manifest.json` with fields: `artifact_name`, `owner`, `ttl_hours`, `redaction_status`. Sample: 
```
{
  "artifact_name": "soc2_excerpt_redacted.pdf",
  "owner": "ana_g",
  "ttl_hours": "48",
  "redaction_status": "PII and IP redacted"
}
```

marcus: Thanks. For the pen-scan ownership line item: who runs the scan? We run the internal infra scan; partner wants to see a signed 3rd-party pen-test attestation. If they already have a pen vendor, fine, otherwise we can provide our recent third-party attestation.

si_partner_rep: They prefer a vendor-signed attestation. Do you have one on file we can share with minimal details?

marcus: Yes — we can share the attestation letter (one page) signed by TrustAssure with scope and date. Will redact IPs.

tom_lee: Great. Action items: (1) @marcus prepare one-line KMS statement + attestation file ready, (2) @ana_g produce presigned links + manifest, (3) @marcus + @ana_g coordinate redaction, (4) @tom_lee confirm upload to partner intake and confirm TTL. Target: send bundle by 2025-08-14 17:00 PT.

si_partner_rep: Confirmed. If anything slips, let me know asap — legal will gate copy. :handshake:

ana_g: Quick question — presign command I'll use: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/partners/acme/manifest.json --expires-in 172800` (I will use 48h by default).

marcus: That works. Also add a short README.txt explaining redaction rules and contact: security@redwood.com.

sec_ops_bot: [automated] Reminder: label artifacts with taxonomy tag `marketplace-evidence/v1` for indexing.

tom_lee: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with partner slack DM once links are live.

ana_g: Uploads ready in ~2 hours. I'll ping the thread when done. :rocket:
